arStrings.szText: Earn {c_highlight}Splinter{/c} ranks to obtain reputation rewards from {c_highlight}Deckard's Table{/c}.
Discover 8 {c_unique}Unique Soul Splinter{/c} socketables, themed around infamous demons of Hell.
Modify {c_highlight}Waking Nightmares{/c} with the {c_questitem}Chronicle of Nightmares{/c} dungeon key for a higher chance of greater rewards!
Use {hotkey:Season} {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} to earn {c_highlight}additional rewards{/c} and uncover your next challenge.
